name.value: N V Mountainview Chalets and RV Resort

description.value: Private RV resort and chalet operation on the edge of McBride in the scenic Robson Valley; offers a full suite of cyclist-friendly amenities including showers, laundry, and device charging, making it a practical service stop on a long valley traverse.

raw_osm.name: N V Mountainview Chalets and RV Resort

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website returns a Wix 'domain not connected' error page, providing zero usable content; all amenity evidence comes exclusively from OSM tags. OSM confirms shower=yes, toilets=yes, laundry=yes, and power_supply=yes, which support those amenity values; drinking_water=unknown, tents=unknown, reservation=unknown, and internet_access=unknown all yield null. The business appears real and operational based on OSM tagging detail and looks_closed=false, though the non-functional website means no contact details can be cross-confirmed.
concerns: Website domain is not connected to any content (Wix placeholder error page); no website-based verification of any details is possible.
pre_enrichment_exclude flag was set due to prefetch_failed_stub — website content is effectively unavailable.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, fee-based campground with detailed OSM tagging on a major BC touring route; non-functional website is a web presence issue, not evidence of closure.
